notes: Specs taken from FOR-A's official datasheet (HVS-390HS_En_160906.pdf) rear-panel diagram and specification table for the HVS-390HS mainframe (3U, 430x450x132mm). This is a modular production switcher: base I/O is 16 SDI inputs and 9 outputs (8 SDI + 1 HDMI), expandable via optional cards (HVS-30HSDI/HSAI/PCIN inputs, HVS-30HSDO/HSAO/PCO outputs) up to 24 inputs / 13 outputs — those option-slot cards are omitted here since they are not part of the standard configuration. SDI grade is listed as HD-SDI 1.5Gbps or SD-SDI 270Mbps (no 3G/6G/12G support), mapped to sdi-hd. HDMI AUX output is explicitly HDCP- and audio-incompatible (video only); no HDMI version is stated so grade is omitted. The rear panel shows two separate AC100-240V 50/60Hz IN inlets (POWER1/POWER2) for the optional redundant PSU configuration (HVS-39PSM) — modeled as two "iec" power ports (exact IEC sub-type, e.g. C13/C14, not stated in the datasheet, but consistent with the included AC cord accessory). RS-422 (x6) is used for VTR/VDCP and router/mixer control (ESAM II); EDITOR port is a dedicated 9-pin D-sub for editor interface. ARCNET port (BNC loop-through) is for connecting external AUX control panels, not a general-purpose network connector, so it is tagged as bnc/other rather than rj45. GPI IN and GPI/TALLY OUT are multi-pin D-sub connectors carrying multiple logical GPI/tally lines (10 in / 20 out) on single physical connectors. Control surfaces (HVS-391OU, HVS-392OU, HVS-392WOU, HVS-392ROU) are separate accessory panels connected via BNC cable to a "TO OU" port on the mainframe and are not included in this port list, which covers only the HVS-390HS mainframe itself.

ports.name: SDI Input 1-16
ports.note: 16x 75Ω BNC, HD-SDI 1.5Gbps or SD-SDI 270Mbps, individually switchable frame synchronizer on each input

ports.name: SDI Output (PGM)
ports.note: 2x 75Ω BNC program outputs, part of standard 8x SDI output group

ports.name: SDI Output (AUX)
ports.note: 6x 75Ω BNC AUX outputs, part of standard 8x SDI output group; crossfade switching available on each AUX output

ports.name: HDMI
ports.note: 1x HDMI AUX output; HDCP and embedded audio not supported

ports.name: REF IN (Genlock)
ports.note: 1x 75Ω BNC, loop-through; accepts Black Burst (NTSC 0.429Vp-p/PAL 0.45Vp-p) or Tri-level Sync (0.6Vp-p); terminate with 75Ω if unused

ports.name: REF OUT (Genlock)
ports.note: 1x 75Ω BNC; outputs Black Burst or Tri-level Sync matching system format

ports.name: EDITOR
ports.note: 9-pin D-sub female x1 (inch screw); editor interface control port

ports.name: RS-422
ports.note: 9-pin D-sub female x6 (inch screw); for external device control (audio mixers, routers, VTR/VDCP units via ESAM II/VDCP protocols)

ports.name: GPI IN
ports.note: 15-pin D-sub female x1 (inch screw), carries 10 discrete GPI input lines on one connector; closest available connector id used, actual connector is a 15-pin D-sub

ports.name: GPI/TALLY OUT
ports.note: 25-pin D-sub female x1 (inch screw), carries 20 discrete GPI/tally output lines on one connector; closest available connector id used, actual connector is a 25-pin D-sub

ports.name: ARCNET
ports.note: 75Ω BNC x1, loop-through; used to connect external AUX control panels (Arcnet type); terminate with 75Ω if unused

ports.name: Ethernet
ports.note: RJ-45 x1, 100BASE-TX/1000BASE-T; used for Web browser control, FTP access for stills/clips, Ethernet-type AUX panels

ports.name: TO OU
ports.note: Connector for control panel (HVS-391OU/392OU/392WOU/392ROU) connection via up to 100m BNC cable; shown on rear panel between LAN and SDI input block

ports.name: AC100-240V IN (POWER1)
ports.note: Primary AC power inlet, 100-240V AC ±10% 50/60Hz; standard AC cord included; exact IEC connector sub-type not specified in datasheet

ports.name: AC100-240V IN (POWER2)
ports.note: Secondary AC power inlet for optional redundant power supply (HVS-39PSM), hot-swappable from front of main unit; same rating as POWER1
